newsitem.title: FRANCE: Don't sign in Amsterdam, French Greens tell Jospin.
newsitem.headline: Don't sign in Amsterdam, French Greens tell Jospin.

text.p: France's Greens, allies of new Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin, warned him on Wednesday against signing the budget stability pact at next week's European Union summit in Amsterdam.
"The Greens ask the French government not to sign anything in Amsterdam," they said in a statement.

"We urge the French government not to fall into the trap of accepting the pact and the Maastricht II Treaty...in return for a plate of lentils, the promise of a 'social chapter' to be added in six months," the environmentalist party said.

The Greens praised Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn for telling EU colleagues in Luxembourg on Monday that the new French government needed time to study the pact, a measure designed to keep the spending of single European currency nations under control.
EU officials have since voiced confidence that a deal could be struck to accommodate French demands and allow the budget pact to be signed by EU leaders in Amsterdam on June 16 and 17.
Jospin appointed French Greens leader Dominique Voynet environment minister in return for their support in last week's parliamentary election which sweptreturned the left to power.
